scope: Source terms for retained named-landmark teaching assets; no new scan acquisition or publication.

afids.verification: Downloaded both small official Git blobs and recomputed their Git SHA-1 identities against the retained revision tree. Current official repository also identifies CC0-1.0.
afids.correction: Historical curation and figure receipts said CC BY 4.0. Preserve those original bytes; use the verified CC0 release statement for current teaching-source attribution. This changes no reference coordinate, score or model outcome.
afids.attribution: Retain dataset, authors, source revision and transformations. Dataset requests citations to Lau et al. 2020 and Taha et al. 2022/2023.

pddca.terms: Public-domain statement in the official source and retained release description; retain authors and release attribution.
pddca.current_review: Official page inspected on 2026-09-28; identifies version 1.4.1 and the public-domain database, with manual bony landmarks.
pddca.attribution: Gregory C Sharp and collaborators; cite the source and Raudaschl et al., Medical Physics 2017.

verse.current_review: Official repository inspected on 2026-09-28 explicitly licenses dataset under CC BY-SA 4.0 and repository code separately under MIT.
verse.attribution: Sekuboyina et al. 2021 and Liebl et al. 2021; preserve ShareAlike and disclose derived reslices/crops/annotations.

atlas.scope: Generic MNI/AFIDs assistance is described using retained commands and archives. The actual runtime image is not retained and is not reconstructed or embedded as if recovered.
